name: Identity Management
description: Controls covering identity and access management including single sign-on, strong authentication, managed identities, and conditional access.

name: Network Security
description: Controls covering network security fundamentals including virtual network segmentation, private endpoints, and firewall configuration.

name: Data Protection
description: Controls covering data protection at rest and in transit, including encryption, key management, and sensitive data discovery.

name: Asset Management
description: Controls covering asset discovery, inventory management, and ensuring proper security configurations for all cloud resources.

name: Logging & Threat Detection
description: Controls covering enabling threat detection, audit logging, and integrating SIEM for security monitoring and alerting.

name: Incident Response
description: Controls covering incident response lifecycle including preparation, detection, containment, and post-incident analysis.

name: Posture & Vulnerability Management
description: Controls covering vulnerability scanning, security assessments, and continuous security posture improvement.

name: Endpoint Security
description: Controls covering endpoint detection and response, anti-malware protection, and device compliance management.

name: Backup & Recovery
description: Controls covering data backup, recovery procedures, and ensuring business continuity through resilient architectures.

name: DevOps Security
description: Controls covering secure development lifecycle, CI/CD pipeline security, and infrastructure as code security practices.

name: Governance & Strategy
description: Controls covering security governance, roles and responsibilities, risk management strategy, and security policies.

name: AI Security
description: Controls covering AI/ML workload security, responsible AI practices, model protection, and AI-specific threat mitigation.
